title: Revalidate remote project before localizing orchestrator proxy
outcome: Remote orchestrator creation clones the local remote-project record, then ensure_remote_project_binding and the remote POST can run before the final inner-lock localization/commit. A concurrent local project deletion can complete its detach sweep during that network window, after which the returned remote orchestrator may be localized from a stale project snapshot. Revalidate project existence and remote identity under the final mutation lock (or otherwise serialize project lifecycle), preserve rollback/error behavior, and add a deterministic deletion-during-remote-create regression.
